subject: I discovered a secret that changes everything about writing
preview_text: You heard it here first. A new feature is coming that will make your current process look ancient.
body_paragraphs: Okay, I need to confess something. I was testing a new feature last night and accidentally wrote a 10-page paper draft in under 7 minutes. My first thought wasn't 'wow'—it was 'every student needs this, right now.'

This isn't just another update. It's the result of watching 50,000+ students fight the same battles: the blank page panic, the all-nighter dread, the fear that your work sounds too 'AI.' We're building the solution. And you're getting the first look before anyone else.

Soon, you won't just generate a thesis. You'll describe your topic in a sentence, and the app will instantly map out a complete, citation-packed paper skeleton—arguments, counterpoints, data visualization spots, the works. It's like having a research assistant who works at the speed of your anxiety.

Want to be among the first to try it when it drops? Open the app and use the 'Generate Thesis' feature on anything. The more you use the core engine now, the smarter this new beast will be for you. P.S. The early testers are seeing their outline-to-draft time cut by 80%. Your next deadline doesn't stand a chance.
cta_text: Open Thesis Generator & Generate a Thesis
